title: Extension by zero of finite constant sheaves is constructible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an etale morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes the representable sheaf h_U and the extensions by zero of finite constant sheaves are constructible, in the three settings of sheaves of sets, abelian sheaves and modules over a Noetherian ring (statement lines 12184-12196). The proof uses the companion stratification result making the morphism finite etale over the strata of a suitable partition (proof lines 12198-12205) and then observes that all the sheaves in question become finite locally constant over those strata (proof lines 12205-12213). The non-formal content is the use of the stratification. The claim is H2: one partition plus three short verifications.
